confidence_interval.excerpt: For kidney cancer, our general analysis suggested only a weak positive relation with milk intake (OR = 1.4; 95% CI 0.7-3.0).

design.excerpt: Relationships between milk intake and cancer incidence were investigated after 11 1/2 years of follow-up of 15,914 individuals.

effect_size.excerpt: How- ever, control for cigarette smoking weakened our estimate of this association (OR = 0.8; 95% CI 0.4-1.5). For kidney cancer, our general analysis suggested only a weak positive relation with milk intake (OR = 1.4; 95% CI 0.7-3.0).

sample_size.excerpt: Among the 16,713 subjects originally included in follow-up, this proce- dure left a total of 15,914 subjects (2,679 women and 13,235 men) with information on milk consumption.

smoking_status.excerpt: Thus, smoking habits are known for the first two groups only.
